mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_cart_item (tenant_id, customer_id, product_id, quantity, price, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{customerId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{deleted}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = IF(deleted = 1, VALUES(quantity), quantity + VALUES(quantity)), price = VALUES(price), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at), deleted = 0
